visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with glasses wearing a brown utility vest over a t-shirt and green joggers is introduced. He stands on an urban sidewalk with buildings and sparse trees in the background. The camera focuses on his uncoordinated outfit. (2) A second man wearing a blue t-shirt with a white sweater tied over his shoulders appears in front of a storefront. He points aggressively at a large illuminated sign that reads '50% FIFTY PERCENT' and then gestures towards the first man. (3) The two men enter a brightly lit clothing retail store. The interior features wooden floors, numerous mannequins wearing trendy apparel, and organized clothing racks. They walk through the aisles, inspecting various items. (4) In a fitting room area, the first man tries on a series of outfits in quick succession. First, a gray tank top with ripped denim shorts; second, a blue long-sleeved sweatshirt while holding balloons; and third, a striped polo shirt paired with a brown pinafore-style apron. (5) The final makeover reveal occurs. The man now wears a clean white t-shirt, a structured beige utility vest, and matching beige cargo pants. He poses confidently in front of a full-length mirror while the second man adjusts his collar. (6) The scene shifts to an interview format within the store. They approach a woman wearing a pink face mask and then a woman in a black jacket and plaid skirt. Everyone ends by posing together for the camera with bright graphical overlays and sparkles appearing on screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-energy upbeat pop music featuring a strong synth bassline. A male voice speaks rapidly with an excited tone, accompanied by 'pop' and 'whoosh' variety sound effects. (2) A sharp transition SFX occurs as a second male voice joins, sounding more authoritative yet comedic. The background music maintains its tempo but slightly dips in volume to accommodate the dual dialogue. (3) During the makeover montage, a rhythmic percussion loop becomes more prominent. Each outfit change is marked by a distinctive 'ding' or 'sparkle' sound effect, emphasizing the visual reveal. (4) As they interview people in the store, the ambient chatter is audible but very low. The voices of the female interviewees are clear and friendly, followed by collective laughter and 'cartoonish' boing sounds for comedic effect. (5) The video concludes with a swell in the background music and a final enthusiastic group shout, ending with a clean audio fade-out and a lingering synth note.
